en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside town beside a steep rocky cliff. A railway line runs in the foreground into a tunnel at the base of the cliff, while a cobblestone street with horse‑drawn carts and pedestrians runs parallel to the river. On top of the high rock face stands a small castle- or villa-like building with a tower, surrounded by trees. At the top left of the image, printed text reads "Bodenbach. Schäferwand."
